name: example-motion-great-figures-resume
title: Great Figures Résumé
description: A 15.53-second period-document opener in which Oda Nobunaga's name is written onto a résumé, the camera reveals his career history, and the paper folds into the Japanese title artwork.

description_i18n.en: A 15.53-second period-document opener in which Oda Nobunaga's name is written onto a résumé, the camera reveals his career history, and the paper folds into the Japanese title artwork.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 一支 15.53 秒的古典文书片头：钢笔在织田信长的履历书上落名，镜头拉远展示其经历，纸张随后折叠并显出日文节目标题。

query.en: Create a 15.53-second period-document opener on warm {{paperColor}} paper. In the first scene, {{penImage}} moves over a Japanese résumé while the surname in {{subjectName}} is progressively written beneath the reading {{subjectKana}}; then pull the camera back through the document, reveal the historical portrait {{portraitImage}}, and pass rows of dated career history, qualifications and personal details with restrained paper drift. In the second scene, fold the two-page résumé inward over a dark wooden desk, compress it into one centered sheet and let the first small version of {{titleImage}} appear as the fold finishes. In the final scene, enlarge {{titleImage}} until its illustrated figures, gold and red lettering, résumé placard and pen fill the warm paper field, then hold the lockup with only subtle breathing, dust and vignette movement.
query.zh-CN: 制作一支 15.53 秒、以暖调 {{paperColor}} 纸张为底的古典文书片头。第一幕让 {{penImage}} 在日式履历书上移动，在读音 {{subjectKana}} 下逐步写出 {{subjectName}} 的姓氏；随后镜头沿文书连续拉远，显出历史人物肖像 {{portraitImage}}，并掠过带年代的履历、资格与个人信息表格，纸面只保留克制的漂移。第二幕让双页履历在深色木桌上向内折叠，压缩成居中的单张纸，并在折页结束时显出较小的 {{titleImage}}。最后一幕放大 {{titleImage}}，直到其中的人物、金红标题字、履历书牌与钢笔占据暖色纸面，再以轻微呼吸、尘点和暗角运动保持定格。
